title: Red Hat Security Advisory: curl security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in the curl packages provided by Red Hat, affecting the libcurl library and curl utility used for file transfers over various protocols. The issues include a security bypass in multi-threaded LDAPS transfers due to global TLS option changes (CVE-2025-14017), a use-after-free vulnerability in HTTP/2 Server Push with shared connections (CVE-2026-18924), and a public key pinning bypass that allows unauthenticated connections (CVE-2026-80230). Red Hat has issued a security advisory with updates to address these vulnerabilities in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and its extended lifecycle versions across multiple architectures. The update is rated as having a moderate security impact. Users are advised to apply the provided updates to mitigate these issues.
